verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out for Kong or Konnect in the evidence. Indirect controls exist: AI Gateway can apply DLP policies that remove PII from traffic to LLM providers, and it centralizes control over AI traffic. Kong can also be self-hosted in DB-less or hybrid mode, which keeps data under the user's control. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that customer data is not used for model training, a documented training opt-out control, provider-level no-training enforcement (e.g., routing only to zero-retention endpoints), and independent corroboration.
